title: 48×48 adult cast, original art and cached layer engine
description:
Beta.5 adds a new original adult fantasy/cyborg cast without embedded creatures, with source art and exact prompt recorded in brand/art-provenance.json. A macOS Swift packaging tool bakes the pixel-styled source into a canonical 192×96 PNG: eight exact 48×48 cells, at most 32 opaque colors per cell, hard alpha and a transparent border. Both native clients crop those same pixels without runtime downsampling, and display on the physical pixel grid. The atlas shrank from 2,380,887 to 22,808 bytes; the signed APK is about 2.3 MB smaller.
The deterministic 48px layer catalog adds independent skin/hair colors, twelve hair styles/outfits/accessories, six expressions/details and twelve independent 16×16 familiars. Native editors offer nine traits, persistent session pins, local seeded remixes and original-look restoration. Six UTF-8 seed/RGBA fixtures match on Swift/Kotlin; asset checks cover color/alpha budgets and shared native bytes. The obsolete 32px writer delegates to the current generator.
Native demo captures and provenance are committed. Keep in progress: custom layered portraits need more visual polish than the authored cast, plus broader physical/small-size/accessibility/tablet acceptance. Adult styling stays non-explicit; source artwork is generated pixel-styled art, with the exact native grid created by the recorded baking step. Release: https://github.com/wckdboy/niobium/releases/tag/v2.0.0-beta.5

title: Validated PixelSpec and design → review → create
description:
Beta.5 expands the validated PixelSpec/review/create flow with nine appearance traits and twelve companion kinds, while preserving six-field saved recipes. Optional skin/hair/detail fields use strict types; seeds and rendered pixels match across Swift and Kotlin. The bot-build JSON example is parsed in the asset suite, and all five skill copies are byte-identical.
The review screen includes a shared native appearance editor, pinned remixes and an independent companion picker. Pins and expanded state survive closing/reopening and lazy-list disposal; native UI regressions verify a pinned hairstyle and mimic selection. iOS review controls freeze during creation, and appearance sheets preserve a pending save. Visual changes preserve persona/access. Offline fallback uses eight distinct role voices and word-based classification, stays labelled as a local template, and respects explicit character cues.
Validation: 33+4 iOS native tests, 29 Android JVM tests, eight Android device/emulator checks and seven asset checks pass; CI run 39822663459 passes shared, Android and iOS. PR #7 is merged; independent final review has no findings. Keep in progress for real-account model generation/provisioning and account/connector acceptance. Further art and naming variety are tracked in NIO-36.

title: Accessibility, tablet layouts and performance
description:
Beta.5 validation passes: 33 iOS unit + 4 native UI tests; 29 Android JVM + 8 runtime/renderer/editor checks; 18 DSH adapter + 13 Hermes watcher tests; 7 asset/catalog checks and 38 standalone Swift assertions. CI run 39822663459 passes shared, Android and iOS jobs. Its downloaded iOS xcresult verifies 37 passed, 0 failed and 2 expected opt-in skips. Both release builds, Android lint, signatures/runtime hashes/16 KB ELF+ZIP alignment, full iOS archive/export and fixture-hook exclusion pass.
The new editor regressions pin hair, close/reopen Appearance, remix and verify retained pins/style and the mimic selection. Portable UTF-8 seeds and RGBA hashes verify cross-platform output. Seven asset checks cover exact 48×48 cast cells, 32-color budgets/hard alpha, twelve 16×16 creatures, shared source/skill copies and reproducible generator drift. The old 32px writer cannot clobber the current catalog.
The final full iOS build 9 acceptance app passed a real DSH turn through a controlled SSE model, partial output and an unfinished turn, an eight-second Home-screen interval with gated final completion, and restored history after a cold app/guest launch in 104.198 seconds. This is simulator evidence, not real-account or physical lifecycle acceptance. Temporary simulator QA apps were removed.
Greptile found two distinct issues, now fixed with regressions; all five threads are resolved. Its 50-credit trial quota blocked the final re-review. Independent Codex review of ed8f661 has no findings.
Keep in progress: physical build 9 iPhone/Android/16 KB, real-account transport/delegation, battery/process death, VoiceOver/TalkBack, dynamic type, contrast/touch targets, tablet/keyboard/safe areas and large histories. Browser visual QA remains unverified after the prior automatic approval denial; site source/links and deployed HTTP bytes are checked. title: Distinct personas and creature generation quality
description:

Model designs stay distinct from clearly labelled local templates. Persona briefings remain 120–600 words, with reviewed tools, permissions and requested connections.
The new authored adult cast is baked into exact 48×48 cells shared by both apps. Procedural recipes support independent skin/hair colors and new hair, expressions, outfits, accessories and details. Legacy six-field recipes remain valid. Both native editors support pinned local remixes and restore; pins survive section closure and lazy-list disposal. Companions render independently at 16×16.
PR #7 merged at 20c4b9218e58a4c1583ddea06fd05165dd08753d. Reviewed and packaged implementation ed8f661 passes CI run 39822663459. Greptile’s two distinct findings were fixed with regressions; its final re-review hit the 50-credit trial limit. Independent Codex review reports no further findings.

title: Evaluate Harness2 for evidence-based Pixel improvement
description: User-linked Harness2 evaluated at google-research/harness2 commit 1cfe254e8d25b15f37048c3730134686abe60335, Apache-2.0, Python 3.12/3.13. Deterministic credential-free demo passed parallel and sequential recursion at k=2: two tasks, zero failures, 28 executions and 32 editor calls. Existing executors are OpenCode/Codex; Hermes/DSH needs a substrate adapter. Proposed next experiment: one bounded probe step per explicitly selected test task on PC/VPS, evidence-based persona/skill/delegation suggestions shown as a reviewed PixelSpec diff, versioned adoption and rollback. Keep secrets, connector authorization and enforced access outside the editable harness. Do not replay side-effecting tasks as probes. Acceptance: real Hermes adapter, independent outcome checks, budget/cancellation/reconnect/partial-failure coverage, evidence redaction and unchanged access. Not integrated or shipped as a mobile runtime. Source and plan: https://github.com/google-research/harness2 and https://github.com/wckdboy/niobium/blob/main/PLAN.md.
